_note: Backend registry for scripts/auto_generate.py, added 2026-08-29 when the operator authorised automated submission. Per CLAUDE.md the tool choice and the spend stay the operator's: there is no default backend, --backend is required, and rates are null until someone fills them from the provider's live pricing with a source and a date. The driver reports image counts either way; it never prints a made-up cost.
_default_backend_note: Deliberately null. Naming one here would be the pipeline picking a paid tool.

mock._note: Writes a valid PNG locally. No network. Exists so the whole harness - resume, retry, backoff, verification, manifest - can be exercised without spending anything. Use it first.

gemini._note: Imagen through the Gemini API predict endpoint. The model id changes as Google ships new versions - model_verified is false until someone checks it against current docs. Reference-image conditioning is only supported by some Imagen variants; if yours does not take one, the driver refuses rather than silently generating 157 frames without the mascot.

fal._note: fal.run is synchronous for most models. reference_encoding data_uri sends the mascot inline as a base64 data URI, which fal accepts wherever it accepts image_url.

replicate._note: Replicate is async: POST returns a prediction, then poll urls.get until status is succeeded. model must be set to a version id (the 64-char hash), not a model name - the driver refuses to run until it is.

flow._note: Browser automation against Google Flow, the route models.json originally described as unreachable. It needs a logged-in Google session: point profile_dir at a Chromium user-data directory you have signed into once by hand. Selectors are null because Flow's DOM is not a stable public API - fill them from the live page. Read the risk note in docs/auto-generation.md before using this: automating a Google product may breach its terms of service and put the account at risk.

rates._note: Null until filled from the provider's live pricing page with a source URL and a date. The driver prints image counts always, and a cost only when a sourced rate exists here. It will not estimate from memory.

limits._note: Delay is applied between requests, not just on retry. Backoff is exponential with jitter and honours Retry-After on 429/503.
